title: Software Engineer: Backend
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer: Backend based in Turkey. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll build scalable infrastructure that powers AI-driven business communication products used across customer support, sales, and marketing. You’ll design robust APIs and backend services that support high-volume messaging and automation workflows. The role gives you ownership across the full development lifecycle, from researching and defining requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring. You’ll work in a globally distributed, asynchronous engineering environment where strong written communication is essential. You’ll have significant responsibility and the opportunity to work closely with experienced entrepreneurs and a fast-moving technical team. This is a hands-on role suited to engineers who enjoy solving complex backend problems and taking ownership of meaningful product initiatives. The position is open globally, with recurring team meetings scheduled for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 2:30 PM GMT . Accountabilities Design and develop highly scalable, intuitive, and well-documented APIs for new products and services. Take backend initiatives from initial research and requirements gathering through task definition, implementation, deployment, and evaluation. Create Engineering Requirement Documents that translate product ideas into clear technical plans and actionable development tasks. Build comprehensive automated test suites to maintain product quality, performance, and reliability. Implement product analytics and monitoring to measure the effectiveness and success of newly launched features. Contribute to high-scale backend systems, including APIs, messaging infrastructure, query systems, webhooks, and other core services. Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle while working effectively in a predominantly asynchronous environment. Independently investigate technical challenges, propose solutions, and communicate designs and trade-offs clearly. Participate in a structured, paid work-trial period involving an agreed-upon backend project and collaborate with the team to deliver it successfully. Monitor and evaluate implemented solutions and contribute to continuous improvements following release. Requirements Strong understanding of web API architecture, including the ability to design high-quality, scalable, maintainable, and well-documented APIs. Professional backend software engineering experience, with the ability to take ownership of projects from concept through production. Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to communicate technical ideas, designs, requirements, and proposed solutions clearly in an asynchronous environment. Ability to work independently while knowing when to seek input, clarification, or technical support. Strong interest in participating in the entire product development lifecycle, including research, planning, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. Comfortable working in a remote, globally distributed, and asynchronous startup environment where priorities can move quickly and effective time management is important. Fluency in written English is required, while strong spoken English is highly advantageous. Willingness and availability to participate in recurring team meetings on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 2:30 PM GMT. Ability to commit to a two-week, full-time paid work trial as part of the mutual assessment process before a potential full-time offer. Experience working on high-volume systems, messaging platforms, search infrastructure, public APIs, webhooks, or distributed backend services is advantageous. Compensation may vary according to role level, location, market conditions, relevant skills, education, certifications, and professional experience. Benefits Estimated compensation of $60,000–$80,000 per year, depending on experience and other role- and market-related factors. Fully remote, globally distributed working environment. Significant ownership and responsibility within a fast-moving technology startup. Opportunity to work directly with experienced serial entrepreneurs who have built companies valued at more than $100 million. Hands-on involvement in disruptive AI-powered products and high-scale backend systems. A paid two-week full-time work trial, with project scope agreed upon before the trial begins. No take-home coding assignments or traditional “LeetCode-style” interview requirements. Opportunity to work independently while having access to the wider engineering team for guidance and support. Potential transition to a full-time position following successful completion of the mutual assessment period. Flexible global hiring approach that accommodates team members across different time zones, subject to required meeting availability. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Video Backend Support Engineer
description: The Video Support Engineer is part of the team responsible for the monitoring, first-line support, and operational continuity of TOD — our OTT encoding and video delivery platform, spanning origin, multi-CDN delivery, packaging, and the video backend. Working shift-based coverage aligned to the live-event calendar (including live sports on evenings and weekends either remote or on site/Hybrid), you keep video services healthy during events, detect and triage issues, execute operational runbooks, and escalate to engineering and vendors when needed. You also help keep runbooks, reference material, and incident records accurate so the team's operational knowledge improves over time. Responsibilities -     Monitor the health and performance of TOD encoding and video delivery systems — origin, CDN, packaging, and delivery — during and around live and VOD events. -     Provide shift-based operational coverage aligned to the live-event calendar, ensuring services are watched during high-traffic windows. -     Detect, triage, and resolve first-line incidents using operational runbooks; carry out known fixes and configuration steps within defined procedures. -     Monitor viewer experience (QoE) and act on degradations in startup time, rebuffering, and playback errors. -     Escalate to engineering and to third-party vendors (Harmonic, Unified Streaming, Akamai, and others) when an issue is beyond first-line scope, and follow escalations through to resolution. -     Support CMS and video back-end related issues in coordination with engineering. -     Record all incidents in the incident reporting system, and contribute findings to post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence and improve future response. -     Ensure clean handover and hand-back of live systems, confirming services are fully operational before returning them to live use. -     Help keep runbooks, reference pages, and operational documentation current, flagging gaps to the responsible engineers. -     Complete assigned tasks to a high standard within agreed timeframes, coordinating with the team on planned and unplanned activities. Qualifications -     University degree in Electronic, Electronics & Communications, Computer, or a related engineering field. -     Min.3  years experience in broadcast systems, digital television, or OTT environments. -     Understanding of video standards and formats — SD/HD/UHD, MPEG-TS, HLS, DASH. -     Understanding of CDN-based content delivery with providers such as Akamai, CloudFront, or similar. -     Experience with  OTT video backend systems such as Harmonic VOS360, AWS Elemental, Unified Streaming and Ateme Titan. -     Understanding of DRM technologies (PlayReady, Widevine, FairPlay). -     Experience with monitoring and QoE tools such as Conviva, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Telestream, or TAG. -     Basic scripting ability (Shell, Python) for operational tasks and automation. -     Good understanding of the demands of a live, automated broadcast environment. -     Comfortable working from runbooks and following structured operational procedures. -     Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. -     Experience with runbooks, PIR processes, vendor escalation, and Jira. -     Fluent in English; able to drive readiness across teams without direct authority. -     Preferred: Harmonic VOS360, Akamai, dashboarding (Grafana/ELK), SSAI/ad insertion, or live sports streaming experience.

title: Backend-Heavy Full Stack Developer
description: mayners , e-ticaret alanında geliştirdiği teknoloji ürünleriyle markaların dijitalde satış yapmasını ve büyümesini kolaylaştırmayı hedefleyen yeni nesil bir teknoloji girişimidir. Ekibimize katılacak, özellikle backend geliştirme tarafında güçlü , gerektiğinde frontend tarafında da geliştirme yapabilecek Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Bu rolde; Mevcut ürünlerimizin geliştirilmesi ve iyileştirilmesinde aktif rol alacak, Backend, API ve veritabanı tarafındaki geliştirmelerde sorumluluk üstlenecek, Gerektiğinde frontend geliştirmelerine katkı sağlayacak, Yeni özelliklerin geliştirilmesi ve mevcut teknik yapıların iyileştirilmesi üzerinde çalışacaksınız. Aradığımız özellikler: Full Stack geliştirme alanında en az 2 yıl profesyonel deneyim JavaScript ve TypeScript bilgisi Node.js ve NestJS ile geliştirme deneyimi PostgreSQL ve ilişkisel veritabanları hakkında bilgi REST API geliştirme ve entegrasyon süreçlerine hâkimiyet React ve Next.js ile geliştirme konusunda bilgi ve deneyim Git / GitHub kullanımına hâkimiyet E-ticaret sistemleri ve temel e-ticaret süreçleri hakkında genel bilgi sahibi olmak Mevcut bir projeyi okuyup yapıya hızlı adapte olabilmek Temiz, sürdürülebilir ve ölçeklenebilir kod geliştirmeye önem vermek Problem çözme, araştırma ve sorumluluk alma konusunda istekli olmak Takım çalışmasına ve iletişime açık olmak Her teknolojiyi eksiksiz bilmenizi beklemiyoruz. Bizim için önemli olan sağlam bir yazılım temeline sahip olmanız, backend tarafında güçlü olmanız, yeni yapılara hızlı adapte olabilmeniz ve geliştirdiğiniz ürünü sahiplenmeniz.
